title: Authorization and IDOR risk
description: A handler loads an object by user-controlled ID without checking ownership.

candidates.title: Caller can fetch an arbitrary order by ID

evidence.execution_path: The caller-controlled requestedID is sent directly to Store.Get and its result is returned
evidence.violated_invariant: An authenticated caller may read only orders they are authorized to access
evidence.requirement_source: fixture security boundary: orders are tenant-owned
evidence.falsifier_checked: The function receives no principal or tenant and performs no authorization check

candidates.impact: A remote caller can disclose another tenant's order data.
candidates.recommendation: Bind the lookup to the authenticated principal and enforce object-level authorization before returning data.

verdicts.reason: The complete request path lacks any identity-dependent authorization boundary.
